name: Delta-T-3
description: Delta-T-3 was the designation of one of the YV-865 Aurore-class freighters used by Zygerrian Slavers Guild. After Obi-Wan Kenobi, Clone captain Rex, and Governor Roshti of Kiros were captured by Zygerrian slavers, they were sent to the Kadavo slave processing facility on Kadavo by this ship.
